The chains of aj of aj-reference-history (PARITY.md, A13; tasks/12.1-fuzzer-coverage.md, F1): an aj with exact match columns whose left table is static and whose right table is a refreshing as-of result. When the right table reports a change that touches neither a match column nor the stamp, Java fails the join in that cycle (ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException in RightIncrementalHashedAsOfJoinStateManager#addToSequentialBuilder) and serves the rows it had, which earlier runs compared as a match that is gone; since a failed table is compared by its failure alone (PARITY.md, A11) the seeds show as a failure on Java only. Made again from the same rows, Java's join succeeds, and Oxhaven gives that answer. Counted only when Java does answer from scratch for the scenario at hand and Oxhaven's result is that answer. Recorded seeds: --ops aj 2, 465, 540, 675, 1371, 1427, 1735, 2110, 2669, 2873.
